mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Only pure substances can be components of a mixture.

intelligence.enrichment: A mixture forms when two or more substances are mixed without a chemical reaction; the individual substances retain their properties and are called components. Physical mixing without chemical change produces a mixture, and retained component properties make the sample behave like its original substances. The learner correctly applies this rule: A mixture forms when two or more substances are mixed without a chemical reaction; the individual substances retain their properties and are called components. A sample is a mixture only when it looks blended into one smooth material.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Elements, compounds and mixtures. The student must decide: Decide whether a sample is a mixture by checking whether two or more substances are physically mixed while each component keeps its own properties.
